title: Nikon Comedy Wildlife Awards 2026 finalists

slides.headline: The funniest animal photos of 2026 just dropped

bg.credit: © Kevin Lohman / Nikon Comedy Wildlife Awards

inset.credit: © Alexander Hormann / Nikon Comedy Wildlife Awards

slides.title: A record year
slides.body: The Nikon Comedy Wildlife Awards got [[over 10,000 entries from 112 countries]]. These are some of this year's finalists.

bg.credit: © Jan Wittmer / Nikon Comedy Wildlife Awards

slides.title: Squirrel vs owl
slides.body: In Santa Cruz, a squirrel launched a [[flying tackle at a young owl]]. Then it did it twice more. Both were unharmed.

bg.credit: © Kevin Lohman / Nikon Comedy Wildlife Awards

slides.title: Bless you!
slides.body: This moose in Alberta, Canada had [[a runny nose, a sneeze, then a big grin]], all caught in one sequence.

bg.credit: © Alexander Hormann / Nikon Comedy Wildlife Awards

slides.title: Listen to your mum
slides.body: In Kenya's Amboseli, a mother elephant gave her calf a dust bath. [[Straight to the face.]]

bg.credit: © Heather Cudworth / Nikon Comedy Wildlife Awards

slides.title: Hair check
slides.body: Three meerkats in Namibia, with one doing a [[last-minute grooming inspection]] before the family photo.

bg.credit: © Subi Sridharan / Nikon Comedy Wildlife Awards

slides.title: Petal power
slides.body: A sunbird pulled out of a flower and [[took the petal with it]]. This one came from an under-16 finalist in Cape Town.

bg.credit: © Phiané Oosthuizen / Nikon Comedy Wildlife Awards

slides.title: Pick a winner
slides.body: Winners are revealed on 8 December, then shown free at London's Gallery@Oxo. [[Which one gets your vote?]]

bg.credit: © Eric Boren / Nikon Comedy Wildlife Awards

caption:
The 2026 Nikon Comedy Wildlife Awards finalists are out, and it's a record year. Winners are announced on 8 December in London, with a free exhibition at Gallery@Oxo from 9 to 13 December. Which one's your winner? 👇

📸 Kevin Lohman, Alexander Hormann, Jan Wittmer, Heather Cudworth, Subi Sridharan, Phiané Oosthuizen, Eric Boren / Nikon Comedy Wildlife Awards

#ComedyWildlife #wildlifephotography
